t: By default, the $(2)Pyramid Mode$() sets the Projector to generate a force field in a pyramid-like shape. The thickness of the pyramid-like shape depends on its size. Each $(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/scale_module)$(5)Scale Module$() increases the size of the field by 1 block in all directions.
默认情况下，$(2)棱锥体模式$()会将投射器设置为生成类金字塔形状的力场。此类金字塔形状的厚度取决于其整体尺寸。每个$(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/scale_module)$(5)扩展模块$()均可使力场在所有方向上同时扩大1个方块。

Placing a $(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/scale_module)$(5)Scale Module$() into an item slot marked by a directional arrow has a different effect. A module placed in either the left, right, front or back item slots will scale the field by 1 block in both opposing directions at the same time. Placing a module in either the up or down item slots will scale the field by 1 block only in that direction.
将$(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/scale_module)$(5)扩展模块$()放入带有方向箭头标记的物品槽中会产生不同效果：置于左侧、右侧、前方或后方物品槽中的模块，将同时在两个相反方向上各扩大力场1个方块；而置于上方或下方物品槽中的模块，则仅在对应单个方向上扩大力场1个方块。

For example, to increase the height of a force field by 1 block; add a $(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/scale_module)$(5)Scale Module$() into an item slot marked by a directional arrow pointing towards the top-left or top-right of the GUI screen.
例如，若要将力场高度增加1个方块，请将$(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/scale_module)$(5)扩展模块$()放入GUI界面左上角或右上角方向箭头所标记的物品槽中。
A scaled $(2)Pyramid Mode$() field being projected.
一个已缩放的$(2)棱锥体模式$()力场正在被投射。
